United Service Companies in Santa Clara is seeking a Security Officer to join our hotel security team. This full-time position includes day, swing and blended shifts, with a focus on protecting guests, staff and property while delivering excellent customer service.

jobs.title: Hotel Security & Safety Specialist
jobs.description:
The Woodlands Resort, Curio Collection by HEI Hotels invites applications for a part-time Loss Prevention Officer. You will patrol hotel grounds, monitor safety systems, respond to emergencies, and coordinate with staff to protect guests, associates and vendors while maintaining a courteous, restrained demeanor.

Ideal candidates communicate clearly, can work on foot for long periods, lift up to 150 lbs, and navigate building layouts.

jobs.title: Guest Safety & Luxury Hotel Security Officer
jobs.description: Houstonian-Campus-LLC in Houston is seeking a dedicated Security Officer responsible for the protection of property and assets while assisting with emergencies. This role is paramount to maintaining the esteemed reputation of The Houstonian Hotel, Club & Spa. Responsibilities include conducting patrols, directing traffic, and responding to emergencies. Prior security experience and proficiency with technology are essential. The position requires stamina for physical tasks and effective communication skills. #J-18808-Ljbffr

jobs.title: Luxury Hotel Security Officer - Guest Safety & Service
jobs.description: The Houstonian in Houston, TX, is hiring a Full Time Security professional. Responsibilities include protecting property and assets, responding to emergencies, and enforcing company policies to maintain luxury standards. The ideal candidate will have a high school diploma or equivalent, 1-4 years of security experience, and strong communication skills. Physical requirements involve frequent standing, walking, and lifting. CPR/AED certification is a plus.
